notes: Generated 30 test methods covering 26 confirmed intents across all DDD layers. Domain layer tests cover constructor validation including auto-generated ID, explicit ID, negative/zero dimension validation, and orientation validation. Application layer tests cover CreateComponentAsync with ID generation, explicit ID handling, duplicate ID detection, retry logic, and validation exceptions. Infrastructure layer tests cover ComponentIdGenerator and SqlLearningComponentRepository with existence checks and add operations. Presentation layer tests cover CreateLearningComponentHandler and endpoint mapping. All tests follow existing project patterns with NUnit 3.14.0, Moq 4.20.72, and AAA pattern with Assert.Multiple for multiple assertions.
